insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, starting in API version 2026-10. This change prevents silently returning incorrect results. The API will explicitly indicate when a metafield is not configured for filtering.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their GraphQL queries to ensure they are only filtering by metafields that are properly configured. This change may break existing queries, so it's essential to test and update them accordingly. The GraphQL Admin API's new behavior will help prevent bugs that are hard to track down due to incorrect results. Developers can use this opportunity to optimize their queries and improve the overall performance of their applications.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and reliable data, as queries will no longer return incorrect results due to misconfigured metafields. This change will improve the overall quality of the data and reduce potential issues that may arise from incorrect filtering.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, which is crucial for building robust and trustworthy applications. By explicitly handling invalid metafield queries, developers can write more robust code and merchants can rely on accurate data.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { namespace: "my_namespace", key: "my_key" }) { edges { node { title } } } }

updates.title: Invalid metafield queries now return errors in the GraphQL Admin API
updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Apps can now subscribe to events for various topics, including metafield changes on products, orders, customers, collections, and locations, using the Events API.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, making it easier to build theme pages, as part of the Liquid July ’26 developer preview.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, making it easier for app developers to build merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview is now available, providing early access to a new set of inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.5.2, fixing a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumping Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.2
updates.summary: The @shopify/cli-hydrogen package has been updated to version 13.0.2, adding non-interactive shop and storefront creation flags to hydrogen link and allowing --force to bypass confirmation prompts in hydrogen upgrade.

updates.title: Updated App Store requirements: 4.1.2 Use a unique name for your app
updates.summary: The App Store requirements have been updated to include a new requirement, 4.1.2, which states that apps must use a unique name to reduce merchant confusion.

updates.title: Storefront API `@inContext` supports `channelId`
updates.summary: The Storefront API @inContext directive now supports a channelId argument, allowing developers to apply a specific sales channel's context to an entire query.

updates.title: `productId`, `title`,`variantSku`, and `variantTitle` fields added to `ExchangeLineItem`
updates.summary: The ExchangeLineItem type now includes productId, title, variantSku, and variantTitle fields, providing more information about exchange line items.

updates.title: POS UI Extensions 2026-07 adds discount allocations to bundle components
updates.summary: The POS UI Extensions API version 2026-07 now includes discount allocations to bundle components, allowing apps to access component-level discount allocations from bundle components in cart line item data.

recap.headline: Enhanced GraphQL Admin API, Expanded Webhooks, and Improved Liquid Templates

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Updates
themes.detail: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries in API version 2026-10, ensuring more accurate results. This change affects queries filtering by metafields not set up for filtering.

themes.title: Webhooks and Events Expansion
themes.detail: New metafield triggers and topics are available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources like Order, Collection, and Location, as well as metafield changes on key objects.

themes.title: Liquid Templates and App Development
themes.detail: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building. Additionally, full-stack capabilities are introduced to power app analytics, streamlining the development process for merchant-facing analytics.

actions.text: Update GraphQL Admin API queries to handle new error responses
